articleTitle: Application of rock brittleness prediction in tight oil exploration
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Brittle rock is one of the key factors in the use of unconventional oil and gas exploration technology to be considered, the stronger the rock brittle fracturing overshoot it easier to constitute seam cracks network, stocks of oil and gas storage layer in the region will thus increase well production will increase. At present mainly based on rock elastic parameters, the use of Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio of two ways to analyze, brittle rock earthquake prediction evaluation. However, since these two methods in the process, both the need for elastic parameters of rock normalized, leading to large errors, adaptability reduce Based on this, we propose a Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio coefficient of utilization of compared to the brittle rock evaluation method to effectively improve the accuracy of prediction and evaluation of brittle rock and anti-jamming capability, while the brittle evaluation method based on the use of pre-stack seismic inversion of elastic parameters to Qijia area of Songliao basin compact oil brittle rock predict deployment guidance wells to obtain stable high level of industrial oil flow.

articleTitle: The tiger bubble oil fields of Daqing have a high platform of sedimentary micro facies reservoir research
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Longhu bubble oil field is located on the west side of the ancient depression of the central depression of the Songliao Basin. It is a large oil-bearing area developed earlier in Daging. Based on the theories of sedimentary petrology, petroleum geology, logging geology, high-resolution sequence stratigraphy and sedimentary microfacies geology, the sedimentary facies is analyzed according to the characteristics of core petrology, sedimentary structural features and so on. Types of. Based on the identification of sedimentary facies, the sedimentary microfacies characteristics, reservoir sand body development, physical properties and oil-bearing characteristics are analyzed. The characteristics of reservoir physical properties are analyzed. The study area is mainly composed of ultra-low permeabilitydense and low porosity and low porosity reservoirs. The physical properties are very poor. After analyzing the physical and oil properties of different sedimentary microfacies in the study area, Dam sand body, thick layer of sand sand thickness, even the film is good, oil is relatively good, is the future exploration and development of the favorable target area.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on oil shale in-situ upgrading by steam injection
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Taking into account the issue of environmental pollution, oil shale in-situ upgrading technology has been the trend of large-scale commercialization in the future. The steam injection with high temperature is an effective method for oil shale in-situ upgrading. We established the mathematical model of oil shale in-situ thermal exploitation. Then, we solved one-dimension model by CMG reservoir numerical simulation software and MATLAB program to calculate the temperature field and pyrolysis oil production. Finally, the model was extended to three-dimension. In the calculation process of simulation, we considered the kerogen pyrolysis reaction and the changing value of permeability, porosity with different temperature fields. The results show that: the temperature of oil shale in-situ upgrading is very important. Only if the temperature exceeds the oil shale pyrolysis temperature, oil can be seen; the changing process of pyrolysis oil production is: no production at first, then oil increasing, decreasing after the peak, at last close to zero; comparing the numerical results and experimental data, we can use the effective value of porosity and permeability in CMG simulation to replace the formation porosity and permeability changing process. The simulation calculation error is small. The article will provide a theoretical basis and technical parameters for insitu exploitation of oil shale with superheated steam technology.

articleTitle: Application of online acidizing technology without pulling string in tight reservoir
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: In tight reservoir, traditional acidizing technology faces the problems of complex process, low efficiency, and easy damage to formation.To solve the problems, an efficient chelating acid system is developed matching with the online acidizing technology without pulling string, which provides a new method for tight reservoir stimulation. In consideration of the compatibility, precipitation inhibition and corrosion inhibition performance, the new acid system is developed with favorable retarding property, strong inhibition ability of precipitation and scale, and low corrosiveness. According to the above characteristics, the online acidizing technology without pulling string is designed to inject the mixture of acid and water into formation with slow speed. The favorable retarding property of this acid system realizes long-term deep formation plug removal. The strong chelating capacity can decrease formation damage by preventing second and third precipitate effectively.The low corrosiveness reduces the corrosion to metal string.With the multiple functions of pre flush, treating liquid, after flush and displacement fluid in conventional acid system,the new one can realize acidification without pulling string, pressure relief, injection suspension, and flow back. Comparing with similar technology, this technology has the advantages of simple process, short duty cycle, and environment friendly.

articleTitle: Pore structure characterization of tight oil reservoirs with fractal theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The microscopic pore structure characteristics of tight oil reservoir are of great importance of effective tight oil development. The fractal dimension can effectively describe the pore size distribution and characterize the heterogeneity of pore structure. There are several methods of calculating fractal dimension from mercury intrusion curve, such as Mandelbrot model, capillary tube model and three-dimensional sphere model, but the calculated results varies from different methods. Using mercury intrusion porosimetry and three different fractal models, the good relationships between fractal dimension and petrophysical properties of tight sandstone core samples have been found, which are beneficial to characterize the heterogeneity of pore structure of tight sandstone reservoirs.

articleTitle: Fully coupled hydromechanical flow simulation of water-induced dynamic fractures in low-permeability reservoirs
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Water-induced dynamic fractures are the new features affecting the reservoir heterogeneity in low-permeability reservoirs. Due to the high injection pressure, water-induced fractures will generate and propagate when the formation pressure exceeds fracturing pressure during water-flood of low-permeability reservoirs. Based on field production data and water-flood behavior analysis in low-permeability reservoirs, propagation mechanism of dynamic fractures is identified and the relationship between fracture aperture and permeability variation with normal and shear stresses is derived. We developed a dynamic fracture model that implicitly coupled fluid flow with the stresses induced by fracture deformation. A crossing criterion is implemented that predicts whether propagating dynamic fracture will cross natural fractures or terminate against them. With dual porosity model, the dynamic fracture model is fully coupled with the fluid flow in matrix and fractures. Simulations were performed of a single propagating fracture to validate the model against classical analytical solutions based on PKN model. Numerical simulation results show that formation pressure controls matrix rock deformation and creation, opening, propagation and closure of dynamic fractures. Unlike the former studies which mainly focus on the normal stress, the study in this paper found that shear stimulation also plays an important role in controlling fracture aperture and permeability. Dynamic fractures increase heterogeneity in low-permeability reservoirs so they significantly affect residual oil distribution after water-flood. The sweep efficiency and ultimate oil recovery can be increased by controlling injection pressure and the range of hydraulic fracturing and optimizing the match between well pattern and dynamic fracture orientation.

articleTitle: Improvement of fuzzy evaluation using fuzzy clustering on identifying thief zones
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: In the late stage of water flooding, thief zones are easily formed as results of long-term washing of injection water and particle migration, which leads to low and noneffective circulation of water injection and low oil recovery. Thus, it plays an important role for the identification and description of low and non-effective circulation. This paper came up with a thought of classification before judgment. First, based on the theory of fuzzy clustering, the appraisal wells were classified and the cluster centers were figured out. The judgment was obtained using fuzzy evaluation, and then the low and non-effective circulation well groups were shown clearly. With the aid of the theory of fuzzy clustering, the limit value between every two levels was not defined, which can eliminate interferences from the artificial factors at a certain extent. On the other hand, the method transfers the evaluation objects from many similar groups to a few different cluster centers relatively. In this respect, this method also reduces the interference from artificial factors.

articleTitle: Waterless stimulation: A new liquid CO2 based gel fracturing fluid with cylinder micelles structure
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Liquid carbon dioxide (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) fracturing technology is one of waterless fracturing technology. It greatly avoids the use of water, reduces reservoir damage, and increase production by improving the reservoir pressure. A new surfactant and thickening agent has been developed and commercialized to meet these challenges, achieving gelled liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in this paper. Surface active agent can make the liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gel by forming wormlike micelle or cylinder micelles structure. Rheology and friction properties of liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gel are evaluated through high pressure pipeline rheological experimental device. Viscosity of liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gel fluid changes with the different pressure(10 to 20MPa) and temperature (0 to 100 °C) under the different shear rate. Effective viscosity of liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gel fluid is 7.654 to 20.012mPa.s. Liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was thickening with viscosity increase at 86 to 498 times under the same conditions. Field application of the new liquid CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> based gel fracturing fluid in two wells of Jilin oil field in china showed the enhancement of production over 100%. 19.8 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> of proppant is successfully pumped to the reservoir in one well, and the mean proppant concentration is 6.8%. After the fracturing, the increase of production is significant by 5~10 times in one tight oil well. The paper will also present the expect application for these fluid, including reservoir characteristics, construction pressure curve, energy storage and closing wells after the waterless fracturing.

articleTitle: Application of sweet spot prediction and integrated geological modeling in the shale gas reservoir of zhaotong block as a national shale gas pilot project
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Unlike the successful development of shale gas basins in North America and other nearby domestic shale gas development zone, Huangjinba block have showed mountainous shale gas features of “strong transformation and over mature”, so the integrated geological and engineering study of reservoir quality, drilling quality, completion quality is quite necessary. Geophysical methods is the core technology followed by 3D geological modeling technology to perform on-site real-time feedback and iterative model updates in order to guide the geo-steering to ensure drilling ratio of high quality shale zone protect the integrity of well bores, and real-time monitor and adjust the parameters of the stimulation. By sweet spot identification technology with 3D seismic AVO inversion and ant-tracking, we could get shale gas reservoir propeties including TOC, gas content and porosity at all, predict the multiscale natural fractures and geomechanics elastic parameters. By 3D geological modeling technology, reservoir property models, multiscale fracture system model and geomechanics model were built and iteratively updated with Real-time new data from drilling, completion and logging. Then, we provided real-time supporting to well placement, drilling, and hydraulic fracturing, minimized the drilling risk, increased the drilling ratio of high quality gas shale zone, and increased the well performance.

articleTitle: Physical property research of CO2 in Yan Chang Oilfield pipeline transportation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The capture, utilization and storage (CCUS) of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has become a hot topic in the current environmental protection field. What's more, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas sources contain various impurities, which may have a great influence on the physical properties of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. So understanding the physical and chemical properties of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with impurities as well as the differences of between it and pure CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, is the basis of carrying out pipeline technology for transporting CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. By comparing the various equations of state, we choose PR equation to calculate the phase state and physical properties of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> containing impurities. In addition, we have used HYSYS software conduct research on 30 MT/a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with impurities of Yan Chang Oilfield. The study shows that its critical point is T=30.37°C, P=7.55MPa. Compared with the pure CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, its critical temperature reduces, critical pressure rises, and there is a two-phase region in the phase diagram, which indicates that the existence of impurities makes it harder to convey CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the pipeline. In the vicinity of critical point, tiny changes from pressure and temperature will make its density, viscosity, thermal conductivity and compression coefficient vary in a large range. Currently, China hasn't established long-distance pipeline to transport CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and we also lack the experience of conveying CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with impurities in pipeline. However, the physical properties of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> containing impurities is primary problem to solve in the pipeline transportation. This paper supplies some its physical properties, which is the fundamental work of developing pipeline transportation for CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Design and test of a new quantitative degasser
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The new quantitative degasser consists of mud collected system, heating system and degassing system. Sampling head, flexible shaft and data acquisition and detection device are included in mud collected system. The sampling head is designed with filter holes and scrapers. The equipment can not only filter the larger grits in the mud, but also prevent the filter holes being blocked. Heating system contains heater and temperature control device. The spiral flute is installed in the heater. And the heater uses electric heating rods to heat the mud. The advantages of heater are their small volume and high heating efficiency. Degassing system consists of degassing tank and power device, while the mud can be stirred and degassed in the degassing tank. The degasser was designed based on the explosion-proof requirement in the well field. And the grade of explosion-proof can reach level 1. Measured by the field tests, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>~C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sub>, benzene, toluene and other kinds of gas composition could be degassed by the new quantitative degasser. Concerning degassing the methane, the degassing efficiency of the new quantitative degasser reached fifty percent, which was 6~10 times higher than the degassing efficiency of electric degasser under the same environment.

articleTitle: Study on flue gas detection and treatment technology in In-situ combustion process of heavy oil
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The In-situ combustion technology has been proved to be a potential technique for heavy oil recovery. Large amounts of flue-gas will be produce In the process of I n-situ combustion. Accurate flue Gas detection results to be a very important security assurance. This paper adopts the method to detect flue-gas by Gas Chromatography and presents a real-time detecting instrument technique. The components of oxygen, carbon dioxide, hydrogen, nitrogen and carbon monoxide in the flue-gas has been accuracy and real-time detected by the methods above mentioned, The detection results have been successfully applied to the oil field. In this paper, the methods of flue-ga s cleaning and reservoir re-injection using in handling th e flue-gas are reviewed. The results of the study showed that flue-gas re-injection technique can eliminate some o f the pollution in the air and enhance oil recovery as well, which is to be the best choice for flue gas processing in hongqian well area of xinjiang oilfield.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) method of shale gas ‘sweet spot’ and fracturing parameters optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the world economy, energy consumption and demand are rising quickly, and shale gas and other unconventional energy sources gradually attract more and more attention. The research of shale gas in China started late, and has yet to establish a sound system of shale gas target preferred. In this study, considering an actual shale gas area in South China, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) method is adopted to determine the `sweet spot' target in the study area, and the quantifiable FCE method of `sweet spot' is developed.. On this basis, the numerical simulation is applied to optimize the design parameters of horizontal well fracturing. The results show that comprehensive influence factor is greater than 0.75 for the high yield region, and 0.4~0.75 for the middle area, less than 0.3 for low production respectively. The fractures optimization results show the fracture halflength 160m, conductivity of 20μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·cm, dumbbell-type fracture morphology, fracture distribution of sparse centers and dense ends, and fracture number 11, makes the development best. This paper constructs a new quantifiable shale gas `sweet spot' evaluation system to guide the exploitation of shale gas, which has strategic significance.

articleTitle: A new method to control the process of MEOR using organic vector
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The technology of Microbial enhanced oil recovery (known as MEOR) has received much concern in recent years and rapid development because of its many advantages. Studies showed that the bacteria could degrade the light component of crude oil preferentially, resulting in the worse rheological characteristic and more difficulty to exploit of crude oil. Focusing on the key problem, this paper studied on a new method using the synergy of an organic matter in the process of microbial flooding that could promote the degradation efficiency of heavy component of crude oil from bacteria by increasing the dissolution of heavy component. With the synergy of additive organic compound, the relative proportion of saturated hydrocarbon has been changed and that of ΣnC21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>/ΣnC22<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> reached up to 39.06% which lead to the forward transference of the peak value distribution curve of hydrocarbon component. Meanwhile, the degradation rate of heavy component of crude oil has been achieved 67.9% and the rheological property altered obviously, the viscosity of crude oil reduced from 124mP·s to 40mP·s. The result of physical simulation displacement test showed that the efficiency of MEOR could be improved 9.72% by using the technology of additive agents and a pilot field test of MEOR has been carried out in ChaoYanggou reservoir in Daqing Oilfield. The field test has given a good effect of increasing oil production and decreasing water cut whose accumulative enhanced oil production was more than 40 thousand tons.

articleTitle: The method of trajectory optimization design and application for 3-D horizontal well in tight oil and gas development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The Ordos basin riches in tight oil and gas resource, which is limited to the landscape environment, tight reservoir characteristics and so on, the traditional way of horizontal well development is costly, and is not effective. In order to meet the low-cost, high-efficiency development, it needs to reduce the construction number of well site, and meet the geomorphology development pattern and the reservoir fracturing requirements. Cluster 3-D horizontal wells drilling pilot test have been carried out. It is a new challenge to drilling the 3-D horizontal well with PDM drilling tools. To solve those difficulties, using the friction and torque of the drill string mechanics analysis, created a design method for trajectory of the 3-D horizontal wells. This method can be used under different drilling conditions, be beneficial to reduce the friction and torque in drilling, and has applied in 267 wells, completed the 3-D horizontal well safely drilling with the maximum offset distance of 302 m and 766 m in tight oil and gas, which is a leading technology in China. It also lays a foundation for large-scale application the cluster 3-D horizontal wells in batch drilling and factory operation.

articleTitle: Early warning system of casing damage for blocks in sandstone oilfield
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Concentrated casing damage has appeared in local area of Changyuan Oilfield in Daqing, which severely leads to substantial economic losses. Therefore, a casing damage early-warning model is established after an in-depth analysis of geological and development factors that affect casing damage by means of big data mining. Four geological early-warning indicatorsare selectedby means ofcore observation, petrophysical experiment, casing damage block anatomy, etc. Blocks are categorized into five levels of casing damage risk according to geological early-warning indicators. The block characterized by fault, fossil layer, sand-mud interface development and large formation inclination has high risk of casing damage. Ten development factors of pressure system and injectionproduction parameters are designed and optimized. Limits of early-warning indicators are determined by analyzing the relationship between each indicator and annual rate of casing damage. Early-warning models for respectively each of five geological risk levels are established through SVM method, achieving early warning in both casing damage risk level and index of block. The prediction coincidence rate forcasing damage of block reaches more than 70%.An early warning system platform for the casing damage has been developed, which enables automatic analysis and early warning as well as real-time early warning of casing damage.

articleTitle: Research on gas desorption characteristics of carbon dioxide in crude oil
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: After gas channeling during CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> flooding, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas content in the produced liquid will gradually increase. Research on desorption law of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in crude oil has not yet appeared in the literature. In the design of gas-liquid separator, in order to desorb CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas effectively, the retention time of produced liquid in gas-liquid separator has to be prolonged appropriately just based on the experience, and the effect is usually not good, leading to serious corrosion of the follow-up equipment. In this paper, the study key point is the desorption law of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in crude oil. The gas desorption experimental device of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> flooding produced liquid is set up, using the method of depressurization for desorption, gas desorption process of the produced liquid in gas liquid separator can be simulated in the condition of gathering temperature and pressure. How the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> desorption rate and desorption percentage change with time is determined. Finally, the desorption rule of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in water and crude oil is obtained. The experimental results show that at the moment of the depressurization, high desorption rate peak of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> appears with short duration. What's more, with the pressure rapidly reducing, desorption rate is falling rapidly. During most of the time when the pressure is the atmospheric pressure, which is the end of the desorption pressure, desorption rate of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in water and crude oil are both below 0.025 Ncm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/(cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·s), and respectively after 20.9 min and 58.60 min, their desorption rates reduce to zero, the desorption percentage reaching only 62.13% and 22.92%. CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas desorption from crude oil is more difficult than that from the water, and the higher oil content in produced liquid is, the more difficult the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas desorption is. So even if the retention time of produced liquid in the separator is far more than that stated in the specification, most of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> still cannot desorb from the produced liquid. By studying the characteristics of desorption of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in crude oil, it is found clearly that only relying on stepdown desorption and prolonging retention time of produced liquid in the separator cannot solve the problem of effective desorption of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. It is recommended to take some measures in the process of gas liquid separation to promote gas desorption. Thus, this paper provides a theoretical basis for the further research on methods of gas desorption.

articleTitle: Reservoir characteristics and controlling factors of E31 clastic reservoir in Qie 6 block of Kunbei Oilfield in Qaidam Basin
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: This paper has detailed description on petrological characteristics, pore type as well as physical characteristics, and it analyses the main controlling factor of reservoir development in combination with sedimentation and rock formation. Based on the data of sections, X-diffraction, scanning electron microscope, rock mercury sections, physical properties analysis, the reservoir characteristics and controlling factors of E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> reservoir in Qie 6 block of Kunbei Oilfield in Qaidam Basin are systematically' comprehensively, detailedly studied. The result shows that the elastic rocks are mainly lithic arkose and feldspathic litharenite with low constitutional maturity and moderate-high textural maturity. The primary intergranular pores are the main reservoir spaces, with the secondary porosity zones and crevice followed. The average porosity of this area is 14.37%, and the average permeability is 35.10×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. As low porosity and low permeability reservoir, it is mostly controlled by sedimentation, diagenesis and tectinization, among which the sedimentation and diagenes are the main controlling factors.The characteristics and controlling factors of E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> reservoirin Qie 6 block of Kunbei Oilfield in Qaidam Basin are studied systematical, comprehensively, and detailedly, then the research has enriched and perfected the geological knowledge of the area.

articleTitle: The influence of unloading process on the shale formation rock mechanics characteristic
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: The oil and gas exploration of shale formation is an unloading process on the rock. After comprehensive study of the mechanical properties of rock under different loading paths is taken, the stability of the excavation of rock can be better evaluated. This paper examines brittle shale on a Longmaxi shale series of mechanical tests, and it analyzes the mechanical properties of different unloading rates through pre-peak unloading confining pressure tests and post peak unloading confining pressure tests. The test results show that in the processes of low confining pressure and pre-peak unloading confining pressure, the strength of Longmaxi shale is more sensitive to the unloading rate. A maximum deformation unloading rate point should exist, which increases slightly with the increase of confining pressure. For post-peak unloading confining pressure, the axial strain decreases with the increase of unloading velocity first, and then it increases, and the change pattern is opposite to that of the pre-peak unloading confining pressure, and the change range is small.

articleTitle: The near miss management: An effective tool for the first-line organizations to do HSE risk management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: This article analyzes the situation of HSE risk management of some typical first-line organizations, the viewpoint that making full use of the near misses is a shortcut to reduce accident rate for those are poor in modern HSE risk management is supported by the near miss management practice. Based on the analysis, the article points out the importance of the near miss management in HSE risk management, its advantages, elements and implementation as a tool for HSE risk management is also explained.

articleTitle: Research of oily wastewater treatment by micro-bubble flotation experimental device
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: To treat oily wastewater with energy saving, low cost and easy operation, a micro-bubble flotation experiment device that can be used indoor is developed. By making a classification of the flotation according to the way of producing micro-bubbles and then analyzing the characteristics of various air flotation devices, the micropore manufactured by laser directly bubbling technique is adopted in micro-bubble flotation experiment device. And the performance of the experiment device for the treatment of oily wastewater was tested. Experimental results prove that the flotation device has high reliability, strong adaptability, easy assembling and oil removal efficiency can reach above 90% under the optimum operation parameters. The micro-bubble flotation experiment device simplifies the bubbling process to study the influence factors of air flotation oil removal efficiency in laboratory, and lays a foundation for the engineering application of micro-bubble flotation oil removal.

articleTitle: Field corrosion test in high H2S containing production flow by using a new testing apparatus
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: A new specially designed corrosion test apparatus was manufactured in order to perform a long-term field corrosion test in FQ oil field, Iraq. The field corrosion test apparatus installation method and the testing procedures were presented in this paper. Several kinds of OCGT materials were fixed inside the test section, such as carbon steel L80 and P110S, and stainless steel 13Cr. The test duration was 98 days; it is longer than the standard recommendation time of three month. The general corrosion rate and pitting attack were evaluated. It was found that pitting attack happened on carbon steel, no pit was observed in 13Cr steel. Long term field corrosion test results have more reliability than short term of laboratory tests.

articleTitle: Research on automatic monitoring and controlling technology downhole for zonal injection in digital oilfield
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: To address the problem of heavy testing workload, high testing costs and fast decreasing of qualification rate of the zonal water influx in the traditionally separated zone, the downhole automatic monitoring and controlling technology is developed. By overcoming the difficulties in downhole signal transmission and the designing of the intelligent water distributor, this technology allows allocating the intelligent injection in each layer. It also offers real-time monitoring and storage of the reservoir data, such as pressure, temperature and flow rate in each layer. Multiple functions are integrated into the water injection strings, incorporating water injection, data acquisition, and auto-flow regulation. This technology has been successfully applied in 50 wells that satisfy the requirements of the auto-flow regulation and the auto-sealing examination. The testing results show that the qualification rate in each layer can be maintained above 95% with an acceptable flow regulation error of 10%. Over 100,000 sets of data have been obtained through real-time monitoring, including zonal temperature, pressure, dynamic and accumulative flow rate. With the extensive database, the change of water injection capacity in each layer can be acquired, providing a reasonable basis for the real-time optimization of the injection strategy.

articleTitle: The identification and analysis of safety critical elements in safety management of oil and gas fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Safety Critical Elements (SCE) are defined as the installations whose failure will cause a major accident or contribute substantially to a major accident, or the installations which can prevent, or limit the consequences of a major accident[1]. By using technological and management methods, and by checking all the SCE in a system, the risk can be reduced significantly and the safety performance can be improved effectively. The use of dangerous materials in oil and gas fields means that the installations in a system are complex processes, increasing the level of risk in oil and gas fields to more than in other industries. Methods based on safety critical elements can help to identify critical installations in the area of safety management rapidly and systematically. With adequate training of managers and operators, safety in the production of the oil and gas can be assured. Compared to other methods of safety management, the use of SCE is more pertinent, its systematicness is more complete, which can enhance the improvement of safety management.

articleTitle: Investigation of microflocculation filtration process on oilfield wastewater by pilot study
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: In order to meet the latest national waste water discharge standards, a set of micro-flocculation filtration unit was added before the previous process, a few significant characteristics were detected. The wastewater used in the paper came from the 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">#</sup> Oil Production Plant, Xinjiang Oilfield. The results showed that the removal rate of oil and suspended solids respectively increased from 91.52% to 95.38% and from 66.42% to 97.19%. After pretreatment by the filtration unit, the relevant characteristics of the discharge wastewater satisfied the latest standard steadily, and the drug dosage reduced at the same time. In order to decrease the degree of scaling on the filter, the ceramicite was chosen as the filter material instead of the quartz sand which was widely used before. The scaling experiment showed that after a certain time's filtration, the extraction concentrations of HCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>, Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and Mg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> on the quartz sand respectively turned to 38.05mg/L, 35.91mg/L and 0.28mg/L, meanwhile those on the ceramsite respectively turned to 13.14mg/L, 6.26mg/L and 0.27mg/L.

articleTitle: Experiment of treatment of polluted sand on well site in the oil field
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: On the analysis of the characteristics of the sample from the oil field, experiments are carried out through hydrocyclone on the sample with different concentration of the solid phase, liquid contents and temperature, flow rate in the laboratory. The results show that the hydrocyclone can be of great value to the cleaning of sand and recycling of oil and sludge by reducing the liquid content in the sand to be fewer than 1% which is far below the national standard 3%. The adoption of the hydrocyclone can do great favors to the reutilization of the useful liquid and the protection of the environment, which can also make certain social profit.

articleTitle: The analysis on reservoir micro-oil of gaotaizi oil in Qijia area
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Qijia area is located in Qijia-Gulong depression in the west of Daqing Placanticle. Gaotaizi oil layer's reservoir is a combination of argillaceous siltstone. It has four oil-bearing formations. Using the effection of sedimentation, diagenesis and waterflood development, combine with the control of sedimentation on primary pore and diagenesis on post reservoir reformation, I combined two kind of facies maps and classified different areas after composite analyzing.

articleTitle: Control of dominant seepage flow on high water cut reservoirs with vector well pattern
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Water flooding is an effective way for oilfield to improve the recovery. However, because of the reservoir heterogeneity, dominant channel of waterflooding is forming after a long-time water injection. In turn, the dominant seepage flow makes the injected water futile cycling. Most of the injected water passes through the dominant seepage unit and cannot effectively spread the low permeability layer, which reduces the water flooding recovery seriously. In order to solve the problem of water channeling during the waterflooding process, a new method, vector well pattern is put forward to control the dominant seepage flow unit, and the proper well space in different permeability direction is confirmed. Meanwhile, the effect of vector well pattern in different transforming time is compared. The results show, in anisotropic formation, the ratio of vector well space is equal to the square root of the ratio of the permeability, and it should be conducted earlier that vector well pattern controls the dominant seepage flow, which makes a better effect. The application of vector well pattern has an important guiding significance for well pattern adjustment in the high water cut reservoir.

articleTitle: Plant-wide control strategy for improving produced water treatment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: This work focuses on investigation and development of an innovative Produced Water Treatment (PWT) technology for offshore oil & gas production by employing the model-based plant-wide control strategy. The key contributions lie in two folds: (i) the advanced anti-slug analysis and control by focusing on the upstream well-pipeline-riser systems; (ii) optimization of controlling topside separation processes, which includes both the three-phase separator and de-oiling hydrocyclone facilities. A new PWT control strategy, named direct efficiency control, has been proposed for guarantee of the PWT quality in a continuous and real-time manner. However, this new solution relies on the availability of reliable Oilin-Water (OiW) real-time measuring technologies, which apparently are still quite challenging and un-matured.

articleTitle: Dissolution characteristic of feldspar in Chang-8 reservoir, DZ and ZY region, Xifeng oilfield of ORDOS basin
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Feldspar dissolution acts as a main mechanism for the forming of secondary pores in Formation Chang-8 of DZ, ZY reservoir, Xifeng Oil Field. In order to clarify the development characteristics and scale of secondary pores in the target zone, this paper has precisely described 150 rock samples from 33 wells and calculated the dissolution degree with the help of technologies involving thin section analysis, scanning electron microscope, X ray diffraction and electron probe microanalysis. The outcomes indicate that feldspar dissolution is universal over the whole target zone, where secondary pores count for as much as 60% of the whole pore space. Secondary pores can be divided, in the view of their shape and structure, into three categories: intergranular dissolved pores, intragranular dissolved pores and composite dissolved pores. Intergranular dissolved pores are harbor-like or arc-shaped pores, formed via local dissolution around the feldspar grain. Intragranular dissolved pores are stripped or cellular pores formed from seepage and dissolution along bicrystal planes or cleavages in feldspar grain. Composite dissolved pores are the combination of the two mechanisms above. On the basis of the dissolution characteristics of the target formation, dissolution rate is defined to quantitatively measure the influence of feldspar dissolution on the pore system. Dissolution degree of the target zone is relatively strong, mainly involving medium dissolution (dissolution rate between 25%-50%), and strong dissolution (dissolution rate between 50%-70% ), which in total cover 80% of the total dissolution degree. The contribution of Different types of feldspars to dissolution rate varies, where secondary pore space from potash feldspar dissolution is about 2.1 times as that from plagioclase. Potash feldspar does not merely play an important role in the forming of secondary pores in burial diagenetic process, its contribution goes higher as dissolution degree enhanced.

articleTitle: Mechanical interaction of multiplefractures propagation for shale fracturing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Multiple cluster perforations are typically used for multi-stage hydraulic fracturing of horizontal wells with casing hole completion to create multiple fractures in any single stage. Due to the mechanical interaction of fractures, the local principal stresses field may alter, which affects the fracture complexity. To optimize the network fracturing design, 3D multiple fractures propagation, stress distribution and fracture mechanics need to be well considered. Firstly, The geometry model for Fuling shale gas formation has been Established, with A depth varying initial in-situ stresses , pore pressure and permeability defined. Then, A linear Drucker-Prager model with hardening is chosen for the rock, while the casing is linear elastic.Based on damage initiation of quadratic nominal stress criterion and damage evolution of B-K critical energy release ratecriterion, the tensile and shear mixed mode fracture model consists of the mechanical behavior of the fracture itself and the behavior of the fluid that enters and leaksthrough the fracture surfaces. Through the selection of general purpose finite element code ABAQUS, the multiple3D fractures propagation process and stress interferences between fractures have been modeled. The results illustrate that mechanical interaction exists between any pairs of fractures, which greatly influences the stress distribution and the geometries and widths of the fractures. Induced stress increase is stronger in magnitude and influences larger region for the minimum horizontal stress than for the maximum horizontal stress. Spacing of perforation clusters and net pressures are two important factors for the successful application of network fracturing. It is possible that the cumulative interaction effect of several fractures could neutralize the stress anisotropy in the formation to enhance the fracture complexity. Taking advantage of the altered stress in the rock for a base case with three fractures, an adequate range of perforation clusters spacing and net pressure are determined for the network fracturing of horizontal wells in Fuling shale gas reservoir, and the treatment designis optimized accordingly . This numerical procedure combined with the post-fracture production rate is also used to evaluate the efficiency of network fracturing for multi-stage fractured horizontal wells in Fuling formation, which can be served as a guidance to optimize the treatment design not only for Fuling but for other shale gas and tight gas reservoirs.

articleTitle: Forward analysis of origin of mixed oil and gas and relative contribution of source rocks in Tarim Basin: A case study from tazhong area
publicationTitle: 2016 International Field Exploration and Development Conference (IFEDC)
abstract: Due to blend of multi-source oil and gas, as well as multiperiod tectonic movements in the Tarim Basin, the origin of marine oil and gas and relative contribution of each set of source rocks that generated them is not clear. Based on oil/gas-source correlation, many geochemists identified the upper-middle Ordovician source rocks as the primary origin of oil and gas in the Tarim Basin. However, the fact that distribution of source rocks with high organic matter (TOC >0.5%) in this unit is quite limited, does not explain the discovery of large-scale reserves of oil and gas, show limitations of geochemical inversion. In this study, the process of hydrocarbon generation, and expulsion from source rocks, and migration, accumulation and destruction of oil and gas were simulated using forward modeling analysis, and finally the amount of prospective resources can be obtained. Results show that the Cambrian-Lower Ordovician source rocks provide more resources than the Upper-Middle Ordovician source rocks, the ratio being 63% to 37%; source rocks with low organic matter provide lesser amount of resources than source rocks with high organic matter, the ratio being 32% to 68%. Ordovician probably has more reserves than the estimated amount because a part of it originates from the deeper Cambrian source rocks or source rocks with low organic matter (TOC ≤0.5%).
